contexts.text: The world and all the offspring thereof () = the Church as to all goods.
Their offspring in the midst of the peoples () = life according to it. AE 768:9.

The reason offspring = those who live according to Divine truth... is that in the Original Language the word offspring is derived from a word which means to go forth and to proceed; and that which goes forth and proceeds from Divine truth when received is a life according to it.
